baseline.scope: Confirmed tracked source, script, fixture, release, and test consumer relations for the initial ARCH-0A Legacy inventory.
limitations: This is an evidence-backed starting inventory, not a claim that future static indexing cannot discover more consumers.
Dynamic or packaging reachability is left unknown unless a concrete path or configuration consumer was found.
A retained V8 fixture or primitive is not product authorization to open V8 authoring projects.

consumerCategoryDefinitions.staticImportsOrReferences: Tracked static imports, calls, Store field reads/writes, or direct symbol references.
consumerCategoryDefinitions.dynamicStringIpcOrConfig: Dynamic import, string lookup, IPC channel, package script, or configuration reference.
consumerCategoryDefinitions.playerPreviewOrExport: Player, try-run, full preview, HTML/Web, PPTX, PDF, DOCX, or export-preflight consumer.
consumerCategoryDefinitions.buildFixtureOrRelease: Build script, fixture generator, benchmark, portability check, packaging, or release verifier.
consumerCategoryDefinitions.persistedRecoveryOrCrossVersion: Persisted archive/export/report, Recovery, or explicit cross-version compatibility relation.
consumerCategoryDefinitions.testConsumers: Tests that directly import, construct, call, or assert the Legacy target.
consumerCategoryDefinitions.cacheAsyncGeneratedOrPackaging: Cache, delayed callback, async flush, generated artifact, embedded bundle, or packaged artifact relation.

startingCounts.countDefinition: A relation is one object in consumerCategories.<category>.confirmed. Unique endpoints are path#symbol pairs across those relations.
startingCounts.reproduce: node -e "const x=require('./docs/development-plan/inventories/legacy-consumers.json');const cats=Object.keys(x.consumerCategoryDefinitions);const rel=Object.fromEntries(cats.map(c=>[c,x.records.flatMap(r=>r.consumerCategories[c].confirmed).length]));const status={};const ep=new Set();for(const r of x.records){status[r.status]=(status[r.status]||0)+1;for(const c of cats)for(const e of r.consumerCategories[c].confirmed)ep.add(e.path+'#'+e.symbol)}console.log(JSON.stringify({recordCount:x.records.length,byStatus:status,confirmedConsumerRelationsByCategory:rel,confirmedConsumerRelationCount:Object.values(rel).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),uniqueConfirmedConsumerEndpointCount:ep.size},null,2))"
